retrievalProfile.description: A character-driven collage featuring a central pitchfork foreground element, a red barn backdrop, and heavy orange block lettering for 90s-style comedy branding.
triggerTerms: heavy orange block title over barn

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-contrast composite image featuring two primary characters in the foreground flanking a silver pitchfork, with a red barn and secondary characters in the mid-ground under a blue sky with wispy clouds.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground characters framing a central vertical pitchfork
Red barn acting as a geometric anchor for the background
Heavy orange title text centered at the top
Contrast between urban/eccentric fashion and traditional rural settings
coreInvariants: Silver three-pronged pitchfork in the lower center foreground
Bright blue sky with scattered white clouds
Red wooden barn with white trim in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale portraits in the left and right foreground; three smaller full-body figures in the center mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The silver pitchfork prongs rising from the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large faces on the sides, down to the pitchfork, then up to the central barn and title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the composition is densely packed with characters and architectural elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Blue (sky) and Green (grass) providing a naturalistic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red (barn) and Orange (text) providing warm focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value, typical of 1990s commercial photography.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between the orange text and blue sky

letterConstructionRules: Heavy block strokes with minimal negative space in counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The word 'IN' is scaled down and nested between the larger words

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over the sky and barn roof

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Small, wide sans-serif for metadata paired with the massive display title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, high-impact feel of 90s comedy titles.
Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a composite image with a bright blue sky and a red barn in the center. Place two large portraits on the left and right foreground, and three smaller figures in front of the barn. Include a silver pitchfork in the bottom center foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, stacked, extra-bold orange sans-serif title at the top center, with the middle word scaled down and nested.

verificationChecks: Is the title text extra-bold and orange?
Is the pitchfork clearly visible in the foreground?
Is the barn red with white trim?
Are the characters arranged in a symmetrical framing composition?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pitchfork has three distinct prongs.
Check that the orange text is not obscured by the background.
Verify the sky is a clear, bright blue.
Confirm the characters are in sharp focus.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Foreground Subject A] and [Foreground Subject B] flanking a [Central Tool/Object] with a [Rural Landmark] background and [Heavy Block Typography] at the top.
